description: Batch-level retained outputs of the 2026-09-26 P1 trial batch: the pin re-verification runs (provenance/verify-pins.sh) and the trial-owned host state cleanup (host-cleanup-20260926/).
sanitization_policy: Private originals are not published; their name, byte count and sha256 are recorded here. They are in this session's scratch directory, in the port's trials-2 tree and the polish passes' trials-pol tree, which remain (README.md#host-state). Published copies replace the session scratch path with <scratch>, the home directory with ~, the user name with <user> (also inside underscore-encoded paths), the runtime directory's user id with <uid> and UUID-shaped identifiers with <uuid>. Files marked verbatim are byte-for-byte copies. Each published copy passed scripts/validate.py PRIVATE_CONTENT and a credential-shape check.

outputs.what: scripts/host_receipts.py validate at the published origin/main commit 9c1669c7, run on a temporary copy of the working tree with the eight first-pass receipts put back into evidence/hosts/ and registered: exactly eight errors, one per receipt, each 'component_id ... is not a known manifests/stack.json or landscape winners component id'; exit 1. This is why the receipts were withdrawn rather than re-recorded.

The verifier version the first run used. Its Hugging Face field check called curl without -L, so it saved the Hub's redirect response instead of the file, and it reported pass without checking that the fields were parsed. Fixed in ../verify-pins.sh (follows redirects; a missing field or unparsable file fails).
First run, retained as a failed attempt: the git, PyPI, npm and Hub revision rows are valid, but its four 'hf .../*.json' rows are vacuous passes with empty field values (the verifier defect above).
The first run's stderr: four JSONDecodeError tracebacks from the unparsed Hub responses.

Output of ../verify-pins.sh (sha256 5badf0e6087a6de46ba36b62d27537f0c8baf3af8932f602bbe2cd148bc5529c): 21 expected passes passed and both must-fail checks failed (a wrong commit for vidore-benchmark v5.0.0, a wrong digest for the colpali-engine 0.3.13 wheel); stderr was empty. The commits, digests and revisions it prints are the registries' own.

The cleanup script (sanitized copy; the session scratch path is replaced by <scratch>, so it is not runnable as published). It asserts each literal target, runs ByteRover's own lifecycle commands, npm uninstall, removes the literal ByteRover state paths and the two /tmp alias symlinks, and stops the three orphaned MIRIX trial servers. Its `brv restart` step scans every process in this WSL distribution and sends SIGKILL to each ByteRover client, daemon or agent it matches, from any install; whether another session's process was hit cannot be ruled out (byterover-cli/README.md#brv-restart-in-earlier-runs).
Plan mode (no changes): every assertion held; listing of the targets before the cleanup (names, sizes, mtimes only).

sanitization.rule: escaped session scratch path (ByteRover project key)

outputs.what: Apply mode: brv providers disconnect / logout / restart (exit 0 each), npm uninstall (exit 0, 778 packages removed), removal of the symlink, the emptied prefix, the four ByteRover XDG directories, the update-notifier file and the then-empty ~/.config/configstore, the two /tmp symlinks, SIGTERM to the three MIRIX servers; after-state checks. Its `brv restart` step scans every process in this WSL distribution and sends SIGKILL to each ByteRover client, daemon or agent it matches, from any install; whether another session's process was hit cannot be ruled out (byterover-cli/README.md#brv-restart-in-earlier-runs).

outputs.what: Read-only capture, before the deletion, of the facts retained evidence still needed from the first pass's scratch trees (pgserver-bundled versions, the mirix 0.1.7 wheel's contents, the attribution of the outside-scratch paths, the trees' sizes). Needs SCRATCH set to the session scratch directory.

The four first-pass scratch trees before deletion (06:37Z), apparent bytes per tree (du -sb, each tree measured on its own) and their top-level entries: trial-colpali 31,053,661,034 (hf-cache 15,063,586,133; .venv 5,677,082,612; .venv-combined 7,547,057,446; .venv-vidore 6,330,727,222), trial-mirix 985,386,322 (venv 694,141,967; venv-main 656,832,321; PostgreSQL data directory pgdata 85,453,825), trial-byterover 19,121,145, exec 54,849.

Why two outside-scratch paths are trial-owned. ~/.cache/mteb was created at 01:29:06Z as the first pass's trial-colpali/.venv first imported mteb 2.21.8 (bytecode written 01:29:03-01:29:06Z); importing mteb constructs its default ResultCache, which creates ~/.cache/mteb (evaluate.py:46; result_cache.py:223, :442). /run/user/<uid>/python_PostgresServer with its .lockfile is pgserver 0.1.4's runtime directory (postgres_server.py:30-31), created 01:29:36Z; its entry 2dcf3c6d23 equals pgserver's socket-directory name for the trial cluster <scratch>/trial-mirix/pgdata (sha256 of path and inode, utils.py:246-251). File sha256 values identify the installed upstream files.

Deletion script: acts only on the literal directories trial-colpali, trial-mirix, trial-byterover and exec directly under the session scratch directory, after asserting each is a real directory that resolves to itself and that no process has its working directory or an open file inside it. The port's trials-2 and the first pass's git worktree wt-trials are deliberately outside the set.
Plan mode: every assertion held for the four literal targets; nothing changed.
Apply mode, 06:38:49Z-06:39:04Z: the same assertions held, the four trees were removed, and each was absent afterwards.
Read-only inventory of the batch's remaining host state (names, types, sizes and timestamps; no credential-bearing file is opened), trial processes and ports.

What remained after the deletion (06:39:48Z): the four first-pass trees absent. Outside the scratch directory: ~/.cache/huggingface/hub (5,962,852,003 bytes: the two vidore model repositories and their .locks entries; the whole directory dates from 02:43:55Z), ~/.cache/huggingface/datasets (10,907,450 bytes: the local slice's datasets cache and lock file; directory from 02:14:42Z), the empty ~/.cache/mteb, ~/.mirix (344,628 bytes) and /run/user/<uid>/python_PostgresServer (a .lockfile and the empty socket directory). Inside it: the port's trials-2 (193,227,040 bytes), the first pass's git worktree wt-trials (117,860,321 bytes; 11 uncommitted entries), this pass's trials-pol and this worktree; 12 other session scratch directories from 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25 under the same root. No MIRIX, ByteRover or pgserver process; ports 18531, 18000, 18533 and 7700 closed; brv not on PATH. Incomplete: it did not look in /tmp, where the ByteRover suite's 501 entries remain, or at the hf_xet log of the unpinned-device download; see remaining-host-state/host-state-inventory.txt. Re-published by the second polish pass, because the first copy kept the user name inside the underscore-encoded name of the datasets lock file.

Current pin verifier (fresh tag clones and git rev-parse, commits fetched by id, PyPI-reported and downloaded sha256, npm dist.integrity and dist.shasum, Hub revisions and config fields, two deliberately wrong expectations that must fail). provenance/run-20260926T045856Z executed this exact version (sha256 5badf0e6087a6de46ba36b62d27537f0c8baf3af8932f602bbe2cd148bc5529c). Our glue.

Source-review generator behind every trial's source-review.json: fetches each named commit by id into a temporary directory and records, per item, the file's blob id, sha256 and the cited lines. Our glue; the claims are the authors'.

Read-only inventory of the batch's remaining host state, second polish pass: names, types, apparent sizes and UTC birth and modification times of the trial-owned paths outside the scratch directory (Hugging Face hub, datasets and hf_xet log, ~/.cache/mteb, ~/.mirix, the pgserver runtime directory) and of the ByteRover upstream suite's /tmp residue by name prefix (from byterover-cli/source-review.json#suite-tmpdir-*), 'hf cache ls', the remaining scratch trees, and trial processes and ports. It opens one file, the hf_xet log, only to count lines naming vidore, and never a credential-bearing file.

The batch's host state at 2026-09-26T10:04:36Z, the basis of README.md#host-state. Outside the scratch directory: ~/.cache/huggingface/hub (5,962,852,003 bytes, born 02:43:55Z; 'hf cache ls' lists exactly vidore/colpali-v1.3 and vidore/colpaligemma-3b-pt-448-base), the hf_xet log born in the same second (197,286 bytes, 4 lines naming vidore), ~/.cache/huggingface/datasets (10,907,450 bytes, born 02:14:42Z), the empty ~/.cache/mteb, ~/.mirix (344,628 bytes), /run/user/<uid>/python_PostgresServer, and in /tmp 498 directories with the ByteRover suite's prefixes plus /tmp/brv-test-blobs, /tmp/brv-test-storage and /tmp/byterover-tool-outputs (22 files), born in four per-minute clusters that match the four suite runs (01:35Z; 01:45-01:46Z; 03:04Z; 03:07-03:08Z).
